description: Defines an enum 'Lwm2mServerIdentifier' representing predefined LwM2M Short Server Identifiers with associated properties and utility methods.

classes.name: Lwm2mServerIdentifier
classes.description: Enum representing predefined LwM2M Short Server Identifiers with properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the integer value of this Short Server ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of this Server ID.

methods.name: isLwm2mServer
methods.description: Checks whether this ID represents a Lwm2m Server.

methods.name: isLwm2mServer
methods.description: Static method to check if a given ID is a valid LwM2M Server ID (1–65534).

methods.name: isNotLwm2mServer
methods.description: Static method to check if a given ID is not a valid LwM2M Server ID.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Returns the enum constant matching the given ID, throws exception if not found.
